skill.name: amazon-listing-competitor-analysis-skill
skill.description: Extracts one Amazon competitor listing by ASIN, then evaluates its content, keywords, visuals, reviews, market gaps, and strategic opportunities.
skill.summary: Turn an Amazon competitor ASIN into evidence-based listing insights and opportunity points.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally runs a local Python script that sends listing parameters and a BrowserAct API key to a fixed third-party API. Most static alerts are Markdown formatting or documentation false positives, but network access, credential handling, and the documented command are confirmed. The guidance also asks users to provide an API key directly to the agent, creating an avoidable credential exposure risk.

remediation.issue: The instructions ask users to provide their BrowserAct API key to the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to configure the key through an environment variable or secret manager, and never request the key in conversation.

remediation.issue: The marketplace URL accepts arbitrary input before submission to the BrowserAct workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Parse the URL and allow only supported HTTPS Amazon marketplace hosts before starting a task.

remediation.issue: Listing inputs and credentials are sent to a third-party service.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the BrowserAct data flow before execution and obtain user confirmation before the first network request.

content.value_statement: Competitor listings contain useful signals, but manual analysis is slow and inconsistent. This skill extracts one ASIN and converts evidence into structured strategic opportunities.
actual_capabilities: Starts a BrowserAct workflow for one ASIN and a selected Amazon marketplace.
Retrieves visible listing fields, media references, seller details, specifications, and available review data.
Maps keyword placement across titles, bullets, descriptions, and available A+ content.
Evaluates content, visual strategy, buyer praise, recurring complaints, and market gaps.
Produces strategic opportunities for positioning, search intent, creative proof, products, offers, or bundles.
limitations: The workflow requires a BrowserAct account, API key, internet access, and available task capacity.
Each run analyzes one ASIN rather than a complete competitor set.
Conclusions depend on fields returned by BrowserAct and cannot verify unavailable conversion or traffic metrics.
A task can run for up to 15 minutes and depends on Amazon and BrowserAct availability.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Listing Overview
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze ASIN [ASIN] on [Amazon marketplace URL]. Summarize the listing, its strongest content choices, and three evidence-based market gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a concise competitor overview.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Keyword Placement
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze ASIN [ASIN] on [marketplace URL]. Map keywords by title, early bullets, later bullets, description, and available A+ content.
prompt_templates.scenario: An SEO specialist needs a placement benchmark.

prompt_templates.title: Find Review-Driven Opportunities
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze ASIN [ASIN]. Compare buyer praise with listing claims, then identify recurring unmet needs from mixed and low-star reviews.
prompt_templates.scenario: A product team needs buyer-validated opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Competitive Opportunity Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze ASIN [ASIN] against this product brief: [brief]. Prioritize positioning, search, creative proof, offer, and product opportunities by supporting evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: A brand team needs an advanced launch strategy.

output_examples.input: Analyze one competitor ASIN and explain its strongest listing choices.
output: Competitor snapshot: The report lists available brand, price, rating, review count, and ranking details.
Content strategy: It explains the title formula, bullet priority, differentiation language, and available A+ modules.
Buyer validation: It connects prominent claims with praise found in helpful reviews.

output_examples.input: Find keyword and visual gaps for a planned product launch.
output: Keyword gaps: The report identifies relevant buyer language that is absent or weakly placed.
Visual gaps: It notes missing use cases, comparisons, scale references, or proof formats.
Opportunity map: It translates each supported gap into a distinct opening for the planned brand.

output_examples.input: Use reviews to identify product and offer opportunities.
output_examples.output: The report groups recurring wishes and complaints, separates defect noise, and proposes supported variant, bundle, warranty, or service opportunities.

best_practices: Use the exact ASIN and regional Amazon marketplace for the listing under review.
Treat extracted fields as the evidence base and label unavailable data clearly.
Compare several separate reports before making high-impact product or positioning decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts or conversation messages.
Do not invent traffic, conversion, keyword volume, or review evidence that the workflow did not return.
Do not present opportunity points as direct edits to the competitor's listing.

faq.question: What input does the skill require?
faq.answer: Provide one Amazon ASIN. You can also provide the matching regional Amazon marketplace URL.

faq.question: Does the skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Configure BROWSERACT_API_KEY locally through an environment variable or approved secret manager.

faq.question: Can it analyze several competitors at once?
faq.answer: No. The bundled script processes one ASIN per run, but you can run separate analyses for comparison.

faq.question: What information can the report cover?
faq.answer: It can cover listing content, keyword placement, visuals, seller details, available reviews, market gaps, and strategic opportunities.

faq.question: How long can an analysis take?
faq.answer: The polling window is up to 15 minutes. Network conditions and BrowserAct task capacity can affect completion.

faq.question: Does it provide verified sales or conversion data?
faq.answer: No. It only analyzes returned listing evidence and should not infer unavailable performance metrics.
